recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14523 unless a future work group separately chooses to revise the broader profiling example.

additional_context: The current source/profiling.html page is the active Profiling FHIR page listed in source/hierarchy.xml and referenced from conformance and documentation pages. Targeted Jira searches found no related issue beyond FHIR-14523 for the expert-system/endocrine wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no human discussion or later decision changing the resolution; Zulip only had tracker, commit, and build bot notifications for GF#14523/14523.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/profiling.html already uses "decision support system" throughout the identified endocrine-report example, and the only remaining "expert systems" source hit is unrelated DiagnosticReport narrative.
